title: LoRa TDMA schedule (proposed contract)

schedule_version.description: Backend monotonic uint32 draft (per Gateway namespace), NOT a raw RF 8-bit SCHED_VER. Cross-layer mapping is BLOCKED at #12.

created_at.description: Backend-issued UTC timestamp; semantic validation requires created_at < expires_at.

expires_at.description: Absolute UTC proposal/command acceptance deadline; MQTT Message Expiry is separate and also mandatory.

profile_id.description: Candidate only (P-10S-15); not validated airtime/RF/HIL profile. Do not treat as approved timing.

superframe_ms.description: Candidate/mock-only value. Actual timing requires #12/G1/G2/G3 review.

min_announce_superframes.description: Number of COMPLETE beacon announcement superframes before switching; Gateway chooses safe activation boundary.

slots.description: Shape only: slot uniqueness, non-overlap, half-duplex, timing/airtime and guards require semantic validation.

description: DRAFT MQTT v1 payload; schema checks local shape, not topic authorization, replay, clock freshness, state transitions or MQTT properties. Cross-team review pending (Issue #14).
